#!name=美柚

#!date=2026-11-21
#!format=sgmodule

[URL Rewrite]
request if ${url} ~= /^http:\/\/x\.seeyouyima\.com\/adx\/staticstics\?/i then reject(404)
request if ${url} ~= /^https:\/\/axxd\.xmseeyouyima\.com\/ad\//i then reject(404)
request if ${url} ~= /^https:\/\/axxd\.xmseeyouyima\.com\/ad_statistics\?/i then reject(404)
request if ${url} ~= /^https:\/\/axxd\.xmseeyouyima\.com\/v1\/getad\?/i then reject(404)
request if ${url} ~= /^https:\/\/axxd\.xmseeyouyima\.com\/pregetad\?/i then reject(404)

[Rule]
DOMAIN, ad.seeyouyima.com,REJECT

[MITM]
hostname = %APPEND% x.seeyouyima.com, axxd.xmseeyouyima.com, config-service.seeyouyima.com
